text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi got injured during 
training, so I rushed her to the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Ow, ow~, looks like I got a little too 
carried away~."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you treated me so well, so I'm 
completely fine now!”

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Let's get right back to training!
choice_data_list:
It looked like you were in quite a bit of 
pain, though?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... But still. Even while I'm doing 
this, everyone else is running so much 
more......!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I'll be left behind! That's 
why... I can't just stay in bed...!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll be careful, so please... please. Let 
me resume training!
choice_data_list:
...Sorry, I can't let you push yourself 
too hard.
If it gets dangerous, I'll stop you.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ngh! I... see. Understood.
choice_data_list:
Let's get plenty of rest and give it our 
all again!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Of course! I'll make up for the time I 
had to rest in no time at all!

Afterward, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi properly 
rested her body just as instructed.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much!

After that, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi returned to 
the track full of confidence, but—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... Yes.

Because Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi pushed herself 
too hard, it seemed she only ended up 
hurting her body more.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Got it! Now that that's settled—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Training resumes right here and now! 
Trainer, please watch me!"
choice_data_list: Right here?! Just what are you planning?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Stretches to loosen up your muscles! They 
help prevent injuries, too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Avoiding the injured area... and stretch. 
This actually helps you fall asleep 
easier, so it kills two birds with one 
stone!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait~, I'll be back in action 
before you know it~!

Putting her knowledge to work after that, 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi made a swift recovery!
